The part of a tree that grows underground is the **roots**.

Regarding the time period of the text: The mention of horse-drawn carriages, gas lighting, and cobblestone streets, combined with Georgian and Victorian architecture and the popularity of Charles Dickens, strongly suggests the **Victorian era** (roughly 1837–1901) in Britain, or perhaps the late 19th century in other Western cities influenced by British culture. Charles Dickens was most prominent during the mid-to-late 19th century, and gas lighting was widely adopted during this period before the widespread electrification of cities.
